basis: Lilly decumbiture/sickness judgment (whole-sign classical rules): Ascendant Scorpio; sixth house afflicted by a planet in his fall placed therein = the disease is seated and the sixth-house affliction is chronic in kind; lord of the Ascendant lately separated from a dexter square of Saturn — the Saturnine cause is past its worst application; Saturn in Cancer expressly signifies the breast and stomach, so the afflicted part is fixed by sign: breast/stomach, a cold melancholic (black-choler/phlegm) oppression there; the Moon in the fourth with Saturn confirms cold, heavy humours settled in the breast and stomach; all angles fixed = the disease is fixed and long, not acute and not quickly removed, but fixity speaks to duration, not to death — no lord-of-eighth/death testimony is stated against the patient, so by grade calibration it is judged curable but slow, not incurable.
prediction_text: The sick doctor's disease lies in the breast and stomach: a cold, melancholic, phlegmatic oppression of the breast and stomach (troubled cough/breath and a weak, laden stomach), from black choler and gross humours. It is curable — he will recover — but the angles being all fixed, the cure will be long and lingering, not speedy.
timing: Month scale (fixed angles, chronic course): recovery gradual over a window of months; no single day is given in the figure as stated, main coordinate is slow amendment over the coming months rather than a dated crisis
